description: This file contains a base class for unit testing Port implementations in the WebKit layout tests framework, including test methods for build checks, configuration, diffing images, crash logs, expectations, and other port-related functionalities.

classes.name: FakePrinter
classes.description: A mock printer class with no-op methods for testing output updates.

classes.name: PortTestCase
classes.description: A unit test class for testing various functionalities of Port implementations, including build checks, diffing images, expectations, and configuration.

methods.name: make_port
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of the Port class or subclass with specified parameters.

methods.name: test_check_build
methods.description: Tests the build checking functionality of the port, including handling missing files and build status.

methods.name: test_default_batch_size
methods.description: Verifies that the default batch size is set correctly when sanitizer is enabled.

methods.name: test_default_child_processes
methods.description: Checks that the default number of child processes is at least 1.

methods.name: test_default_max_locked_shards
methods.description: Tests the calculation of maximum locked shards based on child processes.

methods.name: test_default_timeout_ms
methods.description: Verifies default timeout values for different configurations.

methods.name: test_driver_cmd_line
methods.description: Checks that driver command line includes additional flags.

methods.name: test_diff_image__missing_both
methods.description: Tests diff_image behavior when both images are missing.

methods.name: test_diff_image__missing_actual
methods.description: Tests diff_image behavior when the actual image is missing.

methods.name: test_diff_image__missing_expected
methods.description: Tests diff_image behavior when the expected image is missing.

methods.name: test_diff_image
methods.description: Tests diff_image functionality, including image differences and error handling.

methods.name: test_diff_image_crashed
methods.description: Tests diff_image behavior when the image diff process crashes.

methods.name: test_test_configuration
methods.description: Verifies the test configuration method returns True.

methods.name: test_get_crash_log
methods.description: Tests crash log retrieval with various inputs.

methods.name: assert_build_path
methods.description: Helper method to verify build path construction.

methods.name: test_expectations_files
methods.description: Checks the list of expectations files returned by the port.

methods.name: test_check_sys_deps
methods.description: Tests system dependencies check results.

methods.name: test_expectations_ordering
methods.description: Verifies expectations file ordering and content.

methods.name: test_path_to_apache_config_file
methods.description: Tests the logic for determining the Apache config file path.

methods.name: test_additional_platform_directory
methods.description: Checks that additional platform directories are included in the search path.

methods.name: test_virtual_test_suites
methods.description: Verifies that virtual test suites can be loaded and are iterable.
